project.title: Manager App
project.goal: Provide a simple, reliable tool that helps owners, operators, and teams stay prepared for every service, supporting the delivery of exceptional hospitality.
project.value: Exceptional hospitality and personalized experiences don't happen by accident. They require thoughtful preparation. Tock Manager simplifies reviewing guest details and planning ahead, helping teams execute each service with confidence so staff can focus on what matters most: delivering hospitality that stands out.
project.role: I was the only designer on a small innovation team with two senior iOS engineers. It was a new product, so I owned research, concepts, validation, final designs, and measurement, and acted as product owner for requirements and direction.

images.alt: A calendar of services, a guest detail view, and a guest being swiped as reviewed

next.title: Tock App
next.goal: Create a world-class native app that keeps guests coming back again and again, driving butts in seats for our customers.
next.value: Guests are dining out more than ever, but the abundance of choice can be overwhelming. The Tock consumer app makes it easy to discover and book unforgettable experiences, while helping restaurants, wineries, and hospitality businesses drive demand, fill seats, and grow.
next.role: I was part of a trio stood up specifically to rebuild the Tock consumer app as fully native, replacing a React Native web wrapper. I owned all things design, and acted as product owner and set direction.

images.alt: A restaurant on the map, its profile and experiences, and its awards
